text:
Maya (Marketing): Heads-up — we want to announce the 'Adaptive Batching' release tomorrow at 10:00 AM PST. Need final changelog link, docs anchor, and someone to confirm canary timing + quick flag flip if needed. @Luis can you confirm availability?
Luis (Eng): I can be on for the deploy. Canary plan proposal: start canary at 9:50 (10 min warm), run 10m at 3 nodes, then 30m ramp if metrics look good. If healthy after that, ramp to 30% traffic then full. Quick config snippet I propose to use for the canary:```canary_config
nodes: 3
initial_window_ms: 15
monitoring: latency,errors,95p_latency
```
Aria (Docs): Docs PR is ready for final review: https://git.internal/docs/PR-432 — I still need the final changelog bullets and the headline copy for the docs frontmatter.
Maya (Marketing): Changelog draft lives here: https://drive.redwood/marketing/releases/adaptive-batching.md — please pull the two bullets under the "changelog" section. Marketing will schedule the announcement to go at 10:05 AM PST (blog + tweet thread + webinar signup). Webinar signup goes live at 11:00 AM so announcement needs to be 10:05. @Noah can you start the canary at 9:50?
Noah (SRE): I can start at 9:50. One operational ask: during canary can we reduce batch_window from 25ms -> 15ms to speed up latency signals? That needs a runtime flag flip. @Luis ok to toggle?
Luis (Eng): Yep — I can flip the runtime flag. Command I'll run: `/infra toggle-flag --service=runtime --flag=batch_window_ms --value=15 --env=canary` I'll be online from 9:40-10:30.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment queued for service=runtime, env=canary, user=Luis. ID=cb-1945009876.
Maya (Marketing): Perfect. Marketing will post at 10:05 PST with links to the blog + docs + changelog. Plan: post announcement at 10:05, wait 30m, if metrics clean push ramp to 30% and then full. Aria please publish docs by 9:55 so links are live.
Aria (Docs): Published at 9:52. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/adaptive-batching — frontmatter headline set to: "Adaptive Batching: 2–5x throughput improvements for latency-sensitive workloads"
Noah (SRE): Canary started at 9:50 per schedule. Monitoring looks green so far.
Noah (SRE): Canary green at 10:25. No error spike, 95p latency down 8%. Starting ramp to 30%.
Luis (Eng): Reverted batch_window to 25ms for prod at 10:30 after verifying stability, ramp continuing. All checks passing.
Maya (Marketing): Amazing, thanks all :tada: I'll post the announcement copy in #marketing-drafts in 5 and publish blog at 10:05. Will circle back if anything pops up.
Luis (Eng): I'll stay on until 11:00 to handle any followups.
Aria (Docs): I'll monitor docs traffic and update FAQ if customers ask about batch-window behavior.
Maya (Marketing): Final note — changelog bullets we used are the two under the "changelog" heading in the draft. Copying them into the announcement now.
